principles.statement: Project workflow state lives in .go/ next to code.
principles.rationale: A fresh clone should explain current direction and next work.

principles.statement: Current state is JSON and append-only history is JSONL.
The durable repository map records stable semantic intent; the detailed code graph is a regenerable materialized view of source code and never a competing source of truth.
principles.rationale: Agents need fast application context without turning generated summaries into authoritative architecture or polluting Git history with symbol-level churn.
principles.enforcement: repository-map schema validation, deterministic local indexing, freshness hashes, .go self-exclusion and repository-index conformance checks

principles.statement: Every autonomous go run must define or repair the end goal, acceptance, verification, and task boundary before implementation.
principles.rationale: Autonomy without an explicit goal becomes random feature generation.
principles.enforcement: router/preflight blocks or repairs missing vision, principles, hierarchy, and executable task state

principles.statement: A bare go on a valid .go repo starts the agent command train instead of returning micro-commands for Viggo to run.
principles.rationale: Viggo should provide direction, not repeatedly trigger next/claim/recheck/devil/finish phases.
principles.enforcement: Hermes skill and CLI handoff require immediate tool execution until done, blocker, or budget

principles.statement: A task is not done at first passing verification; recheck/devil/critic and repair/self-reflect must run for non-trivial work.
principles.rationale: Viggo consistently finds gaps after recheck/selfimprove, so the loop must internalize that review stack.
principles.enforcement: loop conductor requires critic verdict before finish for code/docs/contracts/public behavior

principles.statement: The go loop defaults to solo or lead-plus-one-worker; parallel builders require disjoint modify scopes and a reviewer lane, while overlapping modify scopes remain serial.
principles.rationale: More agents can increase context burn, file collisions, and false progress unless capacity and review are explicit.
principles.enforcement: auto/go-loop handoff exposes execution_policy.capacity and regression tests cover solo, serial-review, and disjoint-parallel cases

principles.statement: Planned: de runner beheert de volledige release en sluit de taak pas na het vereiste bewijs.
principles.rationale: Model-success en lokaal afgerond werk bewijzen geen gepubliceerde versie.
principles.enforcement: Released stack v0.3.26 and template v0.3.16 prove the opt-in model/lifecycle contract, owned task workspace and final evidence gates. New projects must explicitly choose profiles and destinations; no implicit model, publication or deployment authority.
